entries.4f05c2ec4eb46f79: A business centered on developing urban rental condominiums and selling them by the whole building (1 building at a time), with Tokyo's 23 wards and locations within a 10-minute walk of a station as the basic development area. It includes real estate development and sales, real estate purchase and sales, real estate brokerage and real estate leasing businesses. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended June 2026 were ¥39,157 million. The consolidated subsidiary K-Nine Co., Ltd. conducts sales of detached houses and townhouses, apartment development, construction work, and land sales in the southwestern part of Tokyo's 23 wards, Kawasaki City, Yokohama City and other areas.
